summary: The quietest week of the relationship - 11 messages - and that quiet is the finding, not the relief. Shayna is deep into her Africa volunteer trip and stopped auditing her own OnlyFans inbox, which is the only detection mechanism this account has ever had. Nothing she flagged the week before was closed: no answer on the Aug 7 fan who claims an untracked custom (now 14 days), no confirmation the vault-notes rule was written, no replacement chatter named, no confirmation the team meeting Fred promised for 8/11 ever happened, and - most seriously - not one word about the fans who already paid for VIP on a promise to see her vagina. No refund, no substitute, no chargeback check, no guardrail. Fred's only two messages all week were to ask her for a custom for a big spender. On the money side Stephski did the right things early - the pre-invoice OF-withdrawal nudge came back on 8/14 and the Aug 1-14 invoice landed on time 8/15 - but it carried yet another account-number change, Shayna did not see it for three days, and her reply 'Will send right now, if it's a new Zelle I may only be able to do 1000 at a time. Let me check' has gone unanswered since 8/18. At week close nothing is confirmed received and the 7-day window expires 8/22. Genuine positives: a second consecutive clean week on feed posts, Michelle's leak report on time again, and Fred asking for custom approval before selling rather than after.

health.rationale: Down 4 from 46. Nothing new broke, which is why the drop is small - but nothing was fixed either, and silence here is not recovery. The highest-risk item on the account (fans who paid for VIP after being promised full nude on 8/10-8/11) went a full week with zero remediation: no refund or substitute decision, no chargeback check, and no mechanical guardrail of any kind - the only action ever taken was removing one chatter and a verbal 'I'll go over in a meeting'. Six commitments aged another seven days, including her Aug 7 untracked-custom question at 14 days and the customs tracker at 32 days. Fred's sole contribution to the week was to ask her for something. A new exposure opened on top: the Aug 1-14 invoice went out 8/15 with a changed account number while she is abroad, she did not see it for three days, her direct question about the $1,000/day Zelle cap has sat unanswered since 8/18, and terms expire 8/22 - the exact setup that produced the late June 15-30 invoice. Offsetting: second clean week with no unauthorized feed posts, Michelle's leak report on schedule, Stephski restored the pre-invoice withdrawal nudge, Fred sought custom approval before the sale for once, and Shayna's tone stayed warm and apologetic rather than escalating.
